description: Synthetic next-turn windows across conversation, interruption, offline work, rumination, and timer-driven initiative.

publication-constraints.content: Speak only when the present stimulus, an explicit prior request, or a grounded material change warrants interruption. Separate completed receipts, active work, paused work, and inference.
